notes.text: The following prose calls sigma an antiautomorphism, involutive and sans p raised-t fixe. Display (27) gives the assignment (alpha,x) to Sigma_alpha^x. Its arrow name, P font, and target subscript remain uncertain. The prose calls the application croissante, discusses its injectivity and order-isomorphism onto its image, and ends with the written abbreviation il f et s. and strictement non panaché. The final hook in elles is retained despite the following singular soit.

Indépendamment de X introduces Définition. The underlined term is maquette/moquette ordonnée, with possible older de at its opening. The parenthesis reads de décompositions n-aires. ordonné is cancelled below inserted fini, and sigma is added high after involution with a diagonal leader. The opening continues ayant la propriété/propriétés suivante/suivantes. The singular article is visibly la, while the two endings stay uncertain.

The cancelled trials remain in full, including their uncertain branch labels, the uncertain sigma x comparison with y, and the final non congrus mod C,. The live braced display has a) and b). In a), an old pair phrase is replaced by x,y comparables; a lower old continuation comparables, et sigma y<sigma x is cancelled and non comparables is written interlinearly. The live b) implication remains below the rising cancellation. The source writes sss. H’s explicit note correctly records the interlinear replacement and the live b) state, and was credited in the comparisons.

The lower slanted NB reads NB implique que x,y compar. => x,y non congrus mod sigma, with congrus uncertain where it crosses the display label. The final main NB begins Cela indique/implique que and calls sigma an antiautomorphism of the ordered set C. It ends with de l’ens ordonné C at the bottom edge.

Mathematical notation was followed for its written attachment and order: the right superscript in the intersection is sigma y, the map assignment uses superscript x and subscript alpha, and the live b) implication has sigma y before sigma x. These were visual checks of transcription. No theorem was proved or independently rechecked, and no semantic correction was substituted for the written mod C, target suffix, grammatical endings, or cancelled relation.
